title: 第10章 狼袭第11章 违抗神明的战士
content_zh:
这几天的训练已经让柯林将原身的战斗经验全部吸收，施法技能的熟练度也涨到了494点，就战斗力来说至少肯定要比刚穿越过来的时候能打。
在狼群迟疑的时候。
居高临下的凯斯可不会有半分犹豫。
只听呼啦一声风响。
又是一匹狼倒在了石弹下，这次离得近了，柯林甚至还能听见头骨破碎的咔嚓声。
逡巡不前的狼群见状再次一拥而上。
柯林盯住打头冲来的对手。
野狼的喘息传到耳边，尖锐的爪牙清晰可见。
就在对手即将到达攻击距离的同时，柯林双目一凝，快速念咒。
在咒语的催动下，粗糙的剑刃上烈焰爆燃而起。
柯林将剑刃猛地挥出，火光随即在来袭的野狼身上炸裂开来，紧接着火焰又从剑刃上射出击中下一只野狼。
【翠炎剑】！
柯林毫不犹豫地扯出短剑，朝周围猛地一挥。
顺着剑尖飞出的火星逼退周围想要冲上来的敌人。
狼群略微后退，继续在周围徘徊。
敌人的大部分精力都被柯林和凯斯吸引，车队其他部分的压力因此减轻了不少。
这下应该稳了吧。
用力稳住发抖的双手，柯林感到相当害怕，但恐惧带来的肾上腺素让他根本来不及恐惧。
他在心底想道，再怎么说，狼这种野生动物狩猎还是为了吃，出现了这么大的伤亡之后，它们应该会想着撤退了吧。
然而事实正好相反。

狼群变得愈发疯狂，只是这份疯狂并没有针对他们这两个硬骨头。
原本在柯林这边的野狼得不到战果，于是迅速分散，对着车队的其他地方发动攻击。
周围到处都是野兽的嘶吼和冒险者们的大叫，柯林的余光甚至还瞧见了一个倒在地上被撕咬的可怜人。
他强迫自己冷静下来。
只要能保住百发百中的凯斯，靠着投石索也够让这群野狼喝一壶的了。
就在和狼群对峙时，柯林忽然发现自己脚下出现了一道影子。
抬头一看，一头白色巨狼正从十几米开外向他扑来。
在这一瞬间。
柯林能清晰地看见从那张满是森白獠牙的巨口中一点点渗出的寒雾，和它那散发着寒光的嗓子眼。
什么样动物的口腔里会有寒雾？
——电影里那些即将吐息的巨龙。
在心底给出答案的瞬间，柯林一个激灵向旁一扑。
刚一落地，一阵寒风便穿透身上亚麻衣物渗到骨子里，叫柯林浑身打了个激灵。
回头看去。
他刚刚站着的土地上竟多出了一层厚实冰块。
而那头和矮种马差不多大小的白狼则站在冰块上，嘴边还有没吐净的白色寒雾。
这野兽浑身冒着淡淡的蓝雾，一双眼睛更是散发着湛蓝的光芒，看一眼就知道这玩意儿和普通野兽全然不同。
这是个什么东西？
柯林心底一沉。
那怪物也看了过来。

它发出呜呜的响动，不断地龇牙咧嘴，好像下一秒就会扑过来似的。
站在马车后方的凯斯扔下投石索，捡起投矛掷出。
锐利的矛尖穿进白狼的腰腹，叫这身形庞大的野兽发出一声痛呼。
“来吧！都来吧！”凯斯捡起另一根投矛扑向白狼，和对方扭打在一起。
content_en:
The past few days of training have allowed Colin to absorb all the combat experience of his original body, and his proficiency in spell casting skills has also increased to 494 points. In terms of combat effectiveness, he is at least better than when he first crossed over.
When the wolves hesitate.
Case, who was condescending, would not hesitate for a moment.
Just listen to the roar of the wind.
Another wolf fell to the stone bullet, this time it was so close that Colin could even hear the crack of a broken skull.
Seeing this, the stagnant wolves swarmed forward again.
Colin stared at the opponent who was charging ahead.
The wild wolf's panting reached his ears, and its sharp claws were clearly visible.
Just when his opponent was about to reach attack distance, Colin's eyes narrowed and he chanted a spell quickly.
Under the influence of the spell, flames burst out from the rough blade.
Colin swung the sword blade violently, and the fire exploded on the attacking wolf, and then the flames shot out from the blade and hit the next wolf.
[Emerald Flame Sword]!
Colin pulled out the dagger without hesitation and swung it around.
The sparks flying out along the tip of the sword push back the surrounding enemies who want to rush forward.
The wolves retreated slightly and continued to wander around.
Most of the enemy's energy was absorbed by Colin and Case, which relieved a lot of pressure on the rest of the convoy.
It should be stable now.
Trying to steady his trembling hands, Colin felt quite scared, but the adrenaline brought by fear made it too late for him to be afraid.
He thought in his heart, no matter what, wild animals like wolves still hunt for food. After such heavy casualties, they should think of retreating.
However, the opposite is true.
The wolves became more and more crazy, but this madness did not target these two strong bones.
The wild wolves who were originally on Colin's side could not get results, so they quickly dispersed and launched attacks on other parts of the convoy.
The roars of wild beasts and the shouts of adventurers were everywhere. From the corner of his eye, Colin even saw a poor man lying on the ground being bitten.
He forced himself to calm down.
As long as Keyes, who was always on target, could survive with his sling, it would be enough to make these wild wolves drink.
While confronting the wolves, Colin suddenly noticed a shadow appearing under his feet.
Looking up, he saw a giant white wolf rushing toward him from a dozen meters away.
At this moment.
Colin could clearly see the cold mist seeping out bit by bit from the huge mouth full of forest white fangs, and its throat exuding cold light.
What kind of animal has cold fog in its mouth?
——Those giant dragons in the movie that are about to breathe.
The moment he gave the answer in his heart, Colin jumped to the side with excitement.
As soon as he landed, a gust of cold wind penetrated his linen clothes and seeped into his bones, making Colin tremble all over.
Look back.
There was actually a thick layer of ice on the ground where he had just been standing.
The white wolf, which was about the same size as a pony, was standing on the ice, with white cold mist still around its mouth.
This beast has a faint blue mist all over its body, and its eyes are even more emitting blue light. One look at it and you can tell that this thing is completely different from ordinary beasts.
What is this?
Colin's heart sank.
The monster also looked over.
It made a whining sound and kept baring its teeth, as if it would pounce on it in the next second.
Keyes, who was standing behind the carriage, dropped the sling, picked up the spear and threw it.
The sharp spear tip penetrated the white wolf's waist, causing the huge beast to let out a cry of pain.
"Come on! Come on, everyone!" Keith picked up another throwing spear and threw it at the white wolf, wrestling with him.
